fields.reason: The paper explicitly compares a retrieval-augmented condition (R) with a parametric-only condition (B) using the same underlying model and benchmark.

selector.exact: The parametric-only model is denoted by its code B and relies on its parametric knowledge alone, never seeing an external source. The retrieval-augmented generator is denoted by its code R and is given the top passages of a dense retriever together with the question.
